lead_independence.headline: Town meeting planned on Jensen Beach flood recovery after families displaced
lead_independence.lead: A town meeting with county, state and federal officials is planned this week for Jensen Beach residents recovering from flooding that displaced families, including Lisa and Jeremy French and their two young boys. The couple previously pleaded for help before the Martin County Commission, seeking longer-term housing and money to repair their home. The planned meeting will give residents a chance to ask about the flooding and recovery assistance.
